component.name: Radix
component.description: With more than enough get up and go to handle your vehicle’s daily energy needs, the Radix from Lightning Power Ltd. is a power plant you can count on to get you where you’re going.

component.name: Frost-Star SL
component.description: Whether cruising across the ground or sailing through space, there’s a J-Span cooler perfect for you. The Frost-Star SL is a mid-tier cooler designed to bring the line’s reliability to ground and open-canopy vehicles.

component.name: PIN
component.description: With the PIN vehicle shield generator you can now trust Seal Corp to protect you whether you’re in space or atmosphere.

component.name: Prevenir
component.description: The Prevenir has been refined by extensive military field testing, making it the go-to vehicle radar for many across the UEE.

component.name: 9-Series Longsword Cannon
component.description: The entry level autocannon of the KnightBridge Arms Sword-line, the 9-Series Longsword fires a ballistic round designed for use against a variety of armored hostiles while allowing pilots to keep a healthy distance from targets.

component.name: MSD-322 Missile Rack
component.description: Behring’s MSD-322 "Marsden" is a complete ordnance storage and deployment system that can be mounted on any compatible size 3 hardpoint for the reliable and effective launch of two S2 missiles.
